mapper.insert: insert into tb_user( id, user_pwd, user_name, gender, phone, email, room_id, user_type )values( #{id}, #{userPwd}, #{userName}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{roomId}, #{userType} )
mapper.select: select u.*, b.building_name as b_building_name, ro.brand as r_brand, ro.floor as r_floor from tb_user u left join tb_room ro on u.room_id = ro.id left join tb_building b on ro.building_id = b.id
mapper.update: update tb_user set user_pwd=#{userPwd}, user_name=#{userName}, gender=#{gender}, phone=#{phone}, email=#{email}, room_id=#{roomId}, user_type=#{userType} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from tb_user where (user_name = #{userName} or id = #{userName}) and user_pwd = #{userPwd}
